notes: Qty 59 as published: the 'Starships (10)' header lists only 9 (Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser x5, Executor, Avenger, Stalker, Tyrant); the other section counts match.

Cards marked {S} (starting): Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi, Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, Oppressive Enforcement, Visage Of The Emperor and Prepared Defenses; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Oppressive Enforcement and Come Here You Big Coward are the Special Edition Effects (no Defensive Shields in August 2000). Coruscant dested the Special Edition Dark system.
Visage Of The Emperor (unique) is posted x5, Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith and Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (unique) x2 each; kept as posted.

Posted 'There'll Be  To Pay x 2' (word missing) dested There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Vader With Light Saber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Grand Moff Trakin' Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Executer' Executor; 'Darth Vader's Lightsaber' Vader's Lightsaber; 'Dagobah Cave' Dagobah: Cave; 'This Is Some Rescue' the Dark A New Hope Interrupt This Is Some Rescue!; Restraining Bolt is the Dark Premiere Device.
The post says the title should read 'Hunt Down and Destroy Them'; the published title is kept.
